title: The Compass of Mount Kessler
author: Jonah Pemberton
blurb: Rafael Brightwater, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
